stage0061_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「...Be grateful, Earthlings.
　Ending your world right now
　is the least mercy I can give」

stage0061_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$田中司令$$
「Glad we made it before things got
　fatal, Colonel Katsuragi」

stage0061_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$ミサト$$
（It's not $c they're after,
　but $$第３新東京市$$... or rather, NERV...）

stage0061_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$ミサト$$
（Does Geminis know about
　《$$リリス$$》 in Central Dogma...?）

stage0061_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$田中司令$$
「Colonel Katsuragi... $$ミサト$$... $$ミサト$$-cchi?」

stage0061_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Sorry.
　I was a bit lost in thought」

stage0061_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「However mighty $c may be,
　spreading their forces thin won't do」

stage0061_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「There's no need to deploy the main force.
　I'll end the world right here」

stage0061_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「So Geminis is using the machines it
　captured as part of its own forces」

stage0061_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$田中司令$$
「Still, it's surprising.
　Not just the Mechanical Beast Army,
　but even the Altair army is here too...」

stage0061_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Lucky you showed up so soon.
　We'll crush them and seize their $$時空震動$$ tech!」

stage0061_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$シンジ$$
（I heard Father's not at NERV HQ,
　but I'll protect this city no matter what...）

stage0061_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Still, why does my partner have to be
　Teacher's Pet...」

stage0061_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$スズネ$$
「It's combination practice, $$アスカ$$.
　Good luck」

stage0061_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$シンジ$$
「$$ミサト$$ said so, that Shikinami and
　Ayanami clearly aren't syncing well」

stage0061_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Fine, I get it!
　No matter who my partner is, I'll make it work!」

stage0061_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$葵$$
「That's the spirit, $$アスカ$$.
　Now just be sure to deliver results」

stage0061_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$スズネ$$
「What's wrong, $n?
　You look so serious...」

stage0061_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Working with Geminis to crush us, huh!?」

stage0061_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$n
「Wait, $$竜馬$$.
　He says he came to lend us a hand」

stage0061_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「I've told $n about my situation.
　First, let's repel Geminis」

stage0061_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「The one who got in our way at Orb...!」

stage0061_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「$$アンナロッタ・ストールス$$,
　thinking it'll all go your way is a grave mistake」

stage0061_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「And I'll teach you the error
　of thinking all of Chrono
　has bowed to you」

stage0061_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$ミサト$$
「All units, work with $$アドヴェント$$
　and intercept Geminis!」

stage0061_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$竜馬$$
「$n!
　I'm leaving you to keep an eye on him!」

stage0061_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Now, let's go, $n...!
　Protect humanity's history with your own hands!」

stage0061_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「$c, damn you...!
　Don't think I came here unprepared!」

stage0061_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$n
「Bluffing looks bad on you, $$アンナロッタ$$!」

stage0061_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Silence!
　I'll show you all a thing or two!」

stage0061_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$ミサト$$
「$$ヘテロダイン$$!?
　Geminis can summon those too!?」

stage0061_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「It's an application of the dimensional tremor.
　By recreating conditions like a $$界震$$,
　they're materializing $$ヘテロダイン$$s in our world」

stage0061_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$田中司令$$
「Now I want their technology more than ever」

stage0061_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$赤木$$
「Those guys...!
　Summoning a $$ヘテロダイン$$!」

stage0061_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$青山$$
「That's the same trick 《$$アイム$$》 Liard used!」

stage0061_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$大杉$$
「Can you hear me, Colonel Katsuragi!
　It's an emergency!」

stage0061_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$ミサト$$
「What is it, Section Chief $$大杉$$!?」

stage0061_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$大杉$$
「A building on the verge of collapse from
　Geminis' attack has citizens trapped inside!」

stage0061_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
Citizen
「It's okay!
　The Federation will come save us!」

stage0061_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$いぶき$$
「There's a power facility near that building!
　The $$ヘテロダイン$$ is after it!」

stage0061_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$青山$$
「So it's drawn to electromagnetic waves and fields!」

stage0061_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$赤木$$
「But the building with those still trapped...!」

stage0061_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I'll stop the building from falling!」

stage0061_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$シンジ$$
「This ought to hold the building...!」

stage0061_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「He's wrapping the building in cable!」

stage0061_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$甲児$$
「Of course, simmered pork!
　It's the same as tying a pork roast with twine
　so it doesn't fall apart while simmering!」

stage0061_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$シンジ$$
「This should keep the building up for a while!」

stage0061_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「No good!
　The $$ヘテロダイン$$ is coming!」

stage0061_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$ミサト$$
「$$アスカ$$!
　Run full speed toward $$シンジ$$!」

stage0061_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Got it!
　Just cross in front of that $$ヘテロダイン$$, right!?」

stage0061_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Now, $$レイ#333$$!
　Pull Unit-02's umbilical cable!!」

stage0061_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Amazing!
　The $$ヘテロダイン$$s got caught on the cable
　and all fell down at once!」

stage0061_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$アスカ$$
「I didn't cross anything!
　You stopped me out of nowhere and made
　my Unit-02 fall over!」

stage0061_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Don't just say 'snapped, huh'!
　It's your fault!」

stage0061_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「That's true.
　Besides, thanks to that the $$ヘテロダイン$$s
　stopped, so just bear with it!」

stage0061_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$シモン$$
「Save your anger for the enemy, $$アスカ$$」

stage0061_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$ミサト$$
「$$シンジ$$, $$アスカ$$!
　The cable's cut, but switch to internal power
　and the EVAs can fight for 5 more minutes!」

stage0061_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$シンジ$$
「But once those 5 minutes are up...」

stage0061_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$ミサト$$
「We'll settle this before then.
　Got it, $$シンジ$$?」

stage0061_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$ミサト$$
「All units, support Unit-01 and Unit-02...!
　We'll drive off the enemy in these next 5 minutes!」

stage0061_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$シモン$$
「That's plenty of time!
　Let's do this!!」

stage0061_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$ミサト$$
「With no cable, watch your EVA's energy
　consumption carefully!」

stage0061_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Chief $$大杉$$, what happened to the stragglers?」

stage0061_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$大杉$$
「Everyone evacuated safely.
　They were all grateful to the EVAs」

stage0061_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$さやか$$
「Somehow we protected the city and NERV HQ, but...」

stage0061_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$ボス$$
「Guess that fierce gal got away after all」

stage0061_04:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$シモン$$
「Then, let's hear it.
　About you and Chrono」

stage0061_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Unfortunately, there's no time for that.
　I must go to space now」

stage0061_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「That's right.
　I'll gather data to break the Prison of Time」

stage0061_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「As for our innocence, ask $n about it.
　When your memory-seal breaks, the real fight begins.」

stage0061_04:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Just $$アドヴェント$$ is fine.」

stage0061_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$n
「...What do you know about the angel...?」

stage0061_04:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「That's my archenemy... my fate, you might say.」

stage0061_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Being able to help you is my pleasure.
　Until we meet again!」

stage0061_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Refreshing, and warm...
　Like someone made from May sunshine.」

stage0061_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$弁慶$$
「Doesn't seem like a two-faced sort」

stage0061_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$隼人$$
「But there's still too much unknown about Chrono.
　We shouldn't trust him too easily」

stage0061_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$甲児$$
「That guy might be chasing $$ガドライト$$
　same as you」

stage0061_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Damn it!
　I can't face the captain like this!」

stage0061_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「I won't let you get away...!」

stage0061_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「If you don't want to die, step out
　of your machine.」

stage0061_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「You...!
　You want me to bear a captive's shame?!」

stage0061_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「I don't want to do this either.
　But if I must...」

stage0061_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Yo... long time, Imitation Boy.
　But I've got no business with you today.」

stage0061_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「$$ガドライト・メオンサム$$...!」

stage0061_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Get away from $$アンナロッタ$$, bud.
　She's our hope.」

stage0061_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「How absurd, $$ガドライト$$.
　You wrapped the Earth in despair, and yet
　you'd speak the beautiful word 'hope'?」

stage0061_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「...I'm not reckless enough to face down
　a $$スフィア・リアクター$$ in its Third Stage.」

stage0061_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Seems you understand a little.」

stage0061_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「I'll tell the Imitation Boy over there too:
　don't get any funny ideas.」

stage0061_04:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「This $$ジェミニア$$ is mine... the Geminaids'.」

stage0061_04:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「...$$ガドライト・メオンサム$$...」

stage0061_04:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$n
「Am I... are we no match for him...?」

stage0061_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「For now, that may be so.」

stage0061_04:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「But tomorrow... the future is unknown.
　That's why $n... you must keep fighting.」

stage0061_04:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「Three minutes since the EVA's cable was cut.」

stage0061_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Hurry, $$シンジ$$!
　Only two minutes left!」

stage0061_04:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「Four minutes since the EVA's cable was cut.」

stage0061_04:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Decide this in the next minute!
　Or the EVA will shut down!」

stage0061_04:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Ngh...!
　Is this as far as we go, Unit-02?!」

stage0061_04:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$ミサト$$
「No good...!
　Without even an A.T. Field raised,
　they'll take concentrated enemy fire!」

stage0061_04:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Seems you've improved since before, $n.」

stage0061_04:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「You can surpass that $$ガドライト$$, I know it!
　Now, go!」

stage0061_04:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「So the Imitation's teamed up with our nuisance!」

stage0061_04:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「I won't allow him to be called the Imitation.
　He's the one man who holds the potential
　to surpass $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$ himself.」

stage0061_04:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Let's go, $n!
　Beating her is our declaration of war
　against $$ガドライト$$!」

stage0061_04:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$シンジ$$
（Even without Dad, I'll fight...!
　I'm part of $c too... of this world!）

stage0061_04:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「How pitiful.
　Forced to fight without even knowing
　what that artificial human even means...」

stage0061_04:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Call it mercy, at least...!
　We'll trigger this Third Impact ourselves!」

stage0061_04:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「As I thought...
　Getter rays are surging on this planet too.」

stage0061_04:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$隼人$$
「This woman... she knows about Getter rays?」

stage0061_04:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Don't listen, $$隼人$$!
　We'll catch her and squeeze every last
　secret out of her anyway!」

stage0061_04:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Not even wit enough to shame your own
　ignorance. Destruction suits you best!」

stage0061_04:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Man of the Spiral...!
　Seems you don't even know the wind's path!」

stage0061_04:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$シモン$$
「I don't know what you're saying,
　but threats like that won't scare me off!」

stage0061_04:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$シモン$$
「Today, I'll beat you down for good,
　and drill through the Prison of Time!!」

stage0061_04:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「How pitiful, you as well.
　No sooner did you think you'd beaten $$バアル$$
　than you got flung to an even worse world.」

stage0061_04:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「The world I'm from, and this world too,
　everyone's living with all they've got!」

stage0061_04:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$ガンバスター$$ is everyone's hope!
　That's why I'll keep on fighting!」

stage0061_04:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「As one who watches over humanity's
　evolution, I'll fulfill that duty!」

stage0061_04:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Geminis! Know the wrath of the one
　who truly bears the name of Chrono!」

stage0061_04:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「What is this person...?
　I don't sense any killing intent at all...!」

stage0061_04:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$レイ#333$$
（What is this...?
　There's a feeling in my chest I've never had...）
